name: Nancy Mace
stance: Opposes AI regulation and a pause as ceding the race to China, and is skeptical of AI companies' safety warnings and of AI doom predictions.

statements.text: America has to win the AI race. China isn’t going to hit pause for anyone.
This AI race to singularity is one we cannot lose, it's a matter of national security and global dominance. This is not the time for regulations, we're full steam ahead.
Every time an AI company warns you they're moving 'too fast,' ask yourself: who's stopping them? Not themselves. But they have the kill switch.
Quote-posted a comparison of Time magazine covers on climate change and "AI will destroy humanity" with the comment "The doom fatigue is real."
If these billion-dollar tech companies are so worried about AI moving too fast, nothing’s stopping them from hitting pause themselves. They won’t. Because this was never about safety.
China, Russia, and Iran are not stopping or dropping this ball. For us to put unnecessary guidelines would be to give them the upper hand.
